run_compose_images: run the script to compose pairs of images side by side from a directory
create_multi_person_images: create multi-person images by concatenating single-person images horizontally using OpenCV
resize_and_concatenate_images: resize two images to matching dimensions and concatenate them horizontally with numpy
batch_image_composition: batch process all image pairs from a directory and save composed results
review_main_function: review the main function that reads images and composes them into side-by-side pairs
